value.rationale: Log-concavity is a standard structural property of graph polynomials and is stronger than the unimodality studied in the motivating 2024 literature. The first failure in a classical distance-regular graph family occurs unexpectedly at T30 despite all 27 preceding nontrivial instances passing; the exact obstruction is at the penultimate coefficient, giving a nontrivial sharp natural finite cutoff, not a table of arbitrary graph samples.
